purpose: Govern shadow evaluation of an unavailable player whose normal football responsibilities are redistributed across multiple positions or role families, without inventing role shares, summing overlapping full-player values, or mutating live Graham numbers.
governingRules: The unavailable player's governed healthy value remains unchanged and is counted once.
A multi-role case must identify the football role families actually redistributed by current team evidence.
Do not split the unavailable player's Walters value into edge, coverage, run-defense, blitz or other role percentages unless explicit governed role-share calibration exists.
Do not add the full Walters values of several replacement players together to replace one player's value.
Players already carrying independent baseline responsibilities may be listed as role absorbers but their full value may not automatically be credited again as replacement value.

When current evidence supports several plausible role absorbers with different locked Walters values and no exact role-share/cascade mapping, use a conservative replacement-value envelope rather than a midpoint.
The envelope is a shadow uncertainty interval only. If it crosses more than one half-point Graham display bucket, fail closed and authorize no live move.
A separate opponent-specific matchup review may be performed, but it may not resolve an otherwise unresolved base replacement interval by reference to narrative alone.
A separate concurrent absence such as suspension or injury must not be folded into this case unless it has its own governed personnel event; avoid double counting.
Market lines, prices, movement and betting percentages are forbidden inputs.

roleFamilyPolicy.rule: Role families describe mechanics only; they do not receive arbitrary numerical weights.

shadowMath.replacementEnvelope: replacementValueMin = minimum locked value among verified incremental role absorbers; replacementValueMax = maximum plausible replacement credit after double-count review.
shadowMath.teamLossEnvelope: teamLossMin = healthyValue - replacementValueMax; teamLossMax = healthyValue - replacementValueMin.
shadowMath.awaySign: pointsToHomeSpread = -teamLoss for an unavailable away-team player.
shadowMath.homeSign: pointsToHomeSpread = +teamLoss for an unavailable home-team player.
shadowMath.displayInvariantGate: Both ends of the shadow exact fair interval must round to the same display number before an interval-derived display can be considered resolved in shadow.

doubleCountGuard.baselineContributor: Do not give full replacement credit to a player already counted in an independent role unless a distinct incremental role is established.
doubleCountGuard.vacatedRoleCascade: If an existing starter shifts to cover the missing player, the role that starter vacates must be resolved before treating the shift as full replacement credit.
doubleCountGuard.concurrentAbsence: A second unavailable player remains a separate personnel event and may not be embedded in the first player's replacement value.
doubleCountGuard.cluster: Do not apply a cluster multiplier unless the existing governed cluster trigger independently passes.
doubleCountGuard.matchup: Opponent-specific matchup effects are downstream of the personnel interval and may not restate the same loss.
